svg.title: Own the Booking Pipe
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-owned-booking-pipe-stack; chapter number: 11; chart type: org_architecture; title: Own the Booking Pipe; subtitle: The software spokes around an off-Turo rental operator; caption: After Turo revoked the unofficial API access Fleetwire and CarSync relied on, operators converged on a direct website plus automated contracts, payment links, e-signatures, and double-booking blocks.; assumptions note: Pricing is as quoted by each speaker at the time; Brandon Duff reported a $34 Fleetwire entry plan versus the roughly $20 tier cited by Alex Auto.; note: Alex Auto (0Q8BZGkkigM @ 00:01:39, 0Q8BZGkkigM @ 00:05:17), Mike_Thebusinessman (1Va2FwAMf2A @ 00:05:18, 1Va2FwAMf2A @ 00:06:27, 1Va2FwAMf2A @ 00:17:13), and Fleet Brothers (VCL-xD3r5VU @ 00:01:08).; center: role: Off-Turo rental operator; headcount: Owner plus two staff accounts on the Fleetwire entry tier; focus: Direct bookings that survive a Turo sync shutdown; spokes: role: Fleetwire; type: Booking site and payment links; kpi: About $20 per month for 5 cars, roughly $240-$250 at 150 cars; role: Fleet Finesse; type: Booking engine with no car caps; kpi: $69 per month standard, $197 deluxe with custom domain; role: Stripe deposit holds; type: Payment layer; kpi: Avoids the 2.7%-2.8% fee; hold falls off on day 7; role: HQ Rentals; type: Rental management suite; kpi: Near $90 plus a $450-$500 setup fee; car caps forced a migration
